scripts.text: I worked myself to death trying to fulfill Lord Kaho's ridiculous expectations for a headgear!
scripts.translation: 为了满足卡浩对头饰那些荒唐的要求，我可把自己折腾得够呛！

scripts.text: Now that I've finally found the formula for the perfect headgear, I'm willing to share my time and talents.
scripts.translation: 现在我终于找到了完美头饰的配方，愿意贡献我的时间和手艺。

scripts.text: You need the following to get the Kaho horns:
scripts.translation: 制作卡浩之角需要以下物品：

scripts.text: 3x ^0055FFEmperium^000000
Oh yeah...
scripts.translation: 哦，对了...

scripts.text: I also forgot to mention these...
scripts.translation: 我还忘了提这些...

scripts.text: We're not done yet, sweetie...
scripts.translation: 还没完呢，亲爱的...

scripts.text: I'm a big fan of dolls, so you need to bring me these cuties!
scripts.translation: 我很喜欢玩偶，所以你得把这些可爱的小家伙带给我！

scripts.text: Finally, I've worked hard to make these horns for my master with all the items mentioned above...
scripts.translation: 最后，我费了好大劲，才用上面提到的所有物品为主人制作这对角...

scripts.text: Please include ^0055FF5 million Zeny^000000 for my efforts.
scripts.translation: 还请支付^0055FF500万Zeny^000000，作为我的辛苦费。

scripts.text: Are you ready for me to make this special item?
scripts.translation: 准备好让我制作这件特殊物品了吗？

scripts.text: Sure am!
scripts.translation: 当然准备好了！

scripts.text: These requirements are unfathomable!
scripts.translation: 这些要求也太离谱了！

scripts.text: What I had to go through was more unfathomable...
scripts.translation: 我当初经历的事情才更离谱...

scripts.text: If you succeed in getting these items, you will have incredible strength!
scripts.translation: 如果你能集齐这些物品，就会变得非常强大！

scripts.text: I can't afford to make this if you don't bring all materials needed. Please understand this is to benefit heroes such as yourself!
scripts.translation: 如果你不带齐所需材料，我也没法制作。请理解，这都是为了造福像你这样的英雄！

scripts.text: Wow! You are brave indeed!
scripts.translation: 哇！你确实很勇敢！

scripts.text: Enjoy being God of Midgard!
scripts.translation: 尽情享受成为米德加尔特之神的感觉吧！
